title: Baby stars in Andromeda: NGC 206
description:
NGC 206 is a stellar association, a young family of bright blue stars in Andromeda. Astronomers say it spans about 4,000 light-years.
NASA picture: JPL, PIA15416. NASA Galaxy Evolution Explorer.
Every day’s picture: https://cosmos.rimilab.com/
Today’s APOD photo is by David Cruz: https://science.nasa.gov/image-article/apod-2026-november-13-ngc-206-and-the-star-clouds-of-andromeda/. To use it, please ask the owner.
